Today Apple released the first iOS 27.2 beta in a surprising move, as no 27.1 version has ever been released before. In addition to a brand-new Health app, iOS 27.2 beta 1 also extends Siri AI support to five additional languages.

Siri AI on iOS 27.2 beta 1 adds support for multiple new languages including French, Japanese, and Spanish

When Siri AI launched alongside iOS 27 just a few days ago, it was only available when the device language was set to English.

At the time, Apple promised more languages would be supported soon, and if you've already installed the developer beta, the wait has been quite short.

iOS 27.2 beta 1 arrives today, bringing Siri AI support for the following new languages:

  • French
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish

Considering this week's release only supported English, this is a significant expansion.

But now, as long as your device language is set to English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, or Spanish, you can use the more powerful Siri AI on the iOS 27.2 developer beta.

Have you tried Siri AI on iOS 27 yet? How does it feel to use? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
